text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?!
You're telling me that I'm older than you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええーっ！
私の方が年上だったんですかっ？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, it seems that way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら。
そうみたいですね～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
You're much more dependable than me,
so I totally thought you were older...
But to hear that I'm two years your elder? I'm shocked.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私よりもしっかりしてるし、
てっきりミサト先生は年上だとばかり……
二つも私の方がお姉さんだったなんて
びっくり。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
But even though you're younger than me, there's no doubt that you're a
proper teacher.
I should follow your example.
text_block_list.orig_text:
けど、
年下でも
先生としてしっかりしてるのは間違いないんだし、
私もミサト先生を見習わなくちゃ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
{0}, are you feeling tired yet?
Let's take a break over here─ Ahhh!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}君はまだ疲れてない？
ここで一度休憩に──
きゃあっ！？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Owww! I tripped!
I'm so sorry, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いった～い、
転んじゃった～
{0}君、
ごめんね～！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Are you both okay?!
Ah, Miss Io! Your knee is bleeding!
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人とも
大丈夫っ！？
あっ、
イオ先生！　
膝から血が……！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Oh, 'tis but a scratch.
More importantly, are you injured, {0}?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
これくらい平気ですよ。
それより
{0}君は怪我してない？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Phew... What a relief.
But even if it feels okay now, it might start to hurt later.
So let me take a proper look.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう……
良かった～
でも、
いまはなんともなくても、
あとで痛むこともあるから、
ちゃんと先生に見せて？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: ...Great! It really does seem like nothing. Thank goodness.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
うん！　
本当になんともなさそうで安心したわ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Ouch!
Now that I know you're fine, my leg suddenly...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いたっ！
君が無事でほっとしたら、
急に足が……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear. Miss Io, please stay still.
I'll take care of it in a jiffy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら
イオ先生、
じっとしててくださいね。
すぐ手当てしますから。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: M-Miss Misato?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミ、
ミサト先生っ？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
{0}, since you've been examined by Miss Io,
I trust that you're okay.
And besides, I know you're a strong boy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}君は
イオ先生が診てくれたし、
大丈夫よね～？
それに、
男の子だもの。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Here we go, Miss Io. You'll be better in no time at all.
Pain, pain, go away! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい、
イオ先生。
すぐに良くなりますからね～
痛いの痛いの、
飛んでけー♪

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Wow... That really was no time at all...
Thank you so much!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごい……
本当にすぐ痛みが……
ありがとうございます～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I'm often carelessly tripping over my own feet like this...
And just as I was saying that I should follow your example...
I'm such an embarrassment.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私、
いまみたいにうっかり転んだりすることが多くて……
ミサト先生を見習ってしっかりしなきゃ、
って思ったばかりなのに
恥ずかしいわ～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
My, my.
Even we teachers are only human.
We're bound to experience failure sometimes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら。
私たち先生も
一人の人間ですから、
失敗することもありますよ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
That aside, it's so nice that you see to your student's injuries before your
own. I'm so moved. To be able to put your students first is the most
important quality for a teacher to have.
choice_data_list: Io is a good teacher who cares about her students.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それより、
自分の怪我よりも
先に生徒の手当てをするなんて
さすがです。
生徒のことを第一に考えられるのが、
私たち先生にとって
一番大事な素質なんじゃないかしら～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: {0}, you feel that way too?
text_block_list.orig_text: {0}君までそんなこと……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I'm still fairly new to being a teacher, so my constant fumbling makes
me unsure of myself. But hearing these words from you two has made
me feel a little more confident!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだ教師になりたてで、
毎日手探りで不安だったけど、
二人がそう言ってくれて、
ちょっと自信がつきました！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
All right! I feel bad for having you stay put for my sake in a place like this.
So let's keep moving forward!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さ、
こんなところで立ち止まってちゃ
君に申し訳ないよね。
じゃあ先に進みましょう！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Eeek!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃあっ？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoaaa...
Be careful here, the ground is really uneven.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──っと、
ととと……
二人とも、
ここ足場が悪いから気を付けてね～？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Okay!
Heheheh. We really can count on Miss Io.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい！
ふふふ、
イオ先生は頼りになるわ～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Come, {0}, let's try to keep up with her!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ{0}君、
一緒にイオ先生について行きましょ～
